chapter.title: Chapter 001 Crossing the Heavenly Gate, Let Whoever Wants to Sign the Investiture of the Gods Can Sign It!

body: "Tongtian! Your Intercept Cult ※18〓s are all nothing more than fur-wearing, horned, wet-born, and egg-hatched beings, ignorant of the heavenly numbers and unclear of the Dao!"
"Now the calamity has arrived, letting them go onto this ※7〓 to fill the positions of the heavenly court's orthodox gods is their fortune!"
"This ※7〓, you must sign it today whether you want to or not!"
※4⛬ sat high above on the cattail mat, his gaze condescending and his tone arrogant.
That aloof posture made it seem as though letting the Intercept Cult ※18〓s sacrifice their lives was a great blessing bestowed upon the Intercept Cult.
Tongtian opened his eyes, a sharp pain throbbing in his head.
A massive flood of memories surged into his mind, and he instantly woke up.
He had actually transmigrated to the ※5⛬, becoming one of the Three Pure Ones and the ※23⛬ of the Intercept Cult, Tongtian!
And the scene before him was the very first discussion of the ※7〓 in ※8⛬, which would determine the trajectory of the ※5⛬ and the life or death of the Intercept Cult!
Tongtian looked around.
On the left, ※4⛬ wore a sneer, pressing aggressively.
On the right, the two Western ※23⛬s, Jieyin and Zhunti, were wiping away fake tears with their sleeves.

Zhunti wailed with a mournful face, "※12⛬ Tongtian, my West is barren, with only a few big cats and small kittens. With these three hundred and sixty-five orthodox gods on the ※7〓, my ※10⛬ is truly powerless!"
"Your Intercept Cult is known as ※11⛬ bowing in court. Wouldn't it be wonderful to casually allocate a few hundred ※3⛬ to fill this ※7〓?"
Jieyin nodded repeatedly from the side, utterly shameless.
And ※6⛬, sitting at the very front, slowly spoke:
"Third Brother, Second Brother speaks reasonably. Your ※18〓s are of mixed quality, so you can just use this calamity to clean house."
Nuwa had not spoken from the beginning.
Although she was unwilling to meddle in this dirty business, it was also impossible for her to offend both the Chan Sect and the ※10⛬ for the sake of the Intercept Cult.
Haotian in the corner kept his head down all along, desperately suppressing the smile at the corners of his mouth.
If the Intercept Cult ※18〓s all filled the ※7〓, the heavenly court would be able to effortlessly take in this massive force of ※11⛬.
As for Daozu ※19⛬ on the highest altar, his eyes were tightly closed, high and aloof, as if everything before him was under his absolute control.
Watching the ugly faces of these people, the anger in the depths of Tongtian's heart instantly flared up to the top of his head.
What a compliance with the heavenly numbers!
What a clearing of the house!
Treating my Intercept Cult as fish meat on the chopping board, to be sliced however they liked?!

The Tongtian in the original book was simply too affectionate and righteous, and was fooled into limping by this bunch of hypocrites, ultimately ending up in the miserable state where the Intercept Cult was destroyed and he himself was imprisoned in ※8⛬!
"Let my Intercept Cult fill the ※7〓? Keep dreaming!"
Tongtian sneered in his heart.
Just as he was about to flip the table, a crisp mechanical voice suddenly sounded in his mind.
[Ding! Detected that the host is facing a life-and-death choice, the ※26⛬ Plunder ※21⛬ has been activated!]

[※21⛬ functions: As long as the host intercepts the ※17⛬, ※13⛬, and ※18〓 originally belonging to others, they can plunder the ※26⛬ of various sects, increase the Intercept Cult's ※26⛬, and obtain generous rewards!]
[Ding! Detected that the host is binding for the first time, a beginner's gift pack has been issued. Open it?]
Tongtian's eyes lit up, the ※9⛬ had arrived!
"Open it!"
[Ding! Congratulations to the host for obtaining the top-grade ※2⛬: ※0⛬!]
[Note: This treasure not only has peerless defense and is immune to all dharmas, but it can also suppress the ※26⛬ of a great sect, enduring through ten thousand kalpas without destruction!]
Tongtian's heart beat fiercely, and the feeling of wild joy was almost unable to be suppressed.
Why did the Intercept Cult lose so miserably in the ※7〓 calamity?
The biggest shortcoming was not combat power at all, but having no supreme treasure to suppress ※26⛬!
Laozi had the Taiji Diagram, Yuanshi had the ※25⛬ Banner, and the West had the 12-grade ※22⛬ golden lotus.
Only the Intercept Cult held the ※1〓 which focused on slaughter. Their ※26⛬ was like a leaky sieve, and once the calamity arrived, all the ※18〓s became cannon fodder.
Now, this sole fatal shortcoming had been made up for!
With this thing, plus his advantage of being familiar with the plot of the ※5⛬, what was there to be afraid of!
"Tongtian! What are you still hesitating about? With ※20⛬ present, do you intend to defy an order?!"
※4⛬ saw Tongtian lowering his head and remaining silent, so he urged him even more unscrupulously, directly bringing out ※19⛬ to suppress him.
Tongtian suddenly stood up, releasing the ※23⛬'s coercion without reservation!
"Sign? I'll sign your grandpa!"
"Defy an order?"
"※20⛬ has never spoken from beginning to end. When did he ever command this seat to sign the ※7〓?"
Tongtian took a step forward, staring fixedly at Yuanshi.
"Or could it be that in this ※8⛬ now, it is your turn to make decisions on behalf of ※20⛬?"
As soon as these words were spoken, ※8⛬ instantly fell dead silent.
※4⛬ was trembling all over with anger, his face turning pale-blue as he pointed at Tongtian and roared:
"Tongtian! You are presumptuous!"
"Your Intercept Cult has no objects to suppress ※26⛬, and is doomed to be reduced to ashes in the calamity! This is the heavenly number!"
"If you do not sign, you are acting in a ※15⛬ manner!"
"Heavenly numbers?"
Tongtian let out a wild laugh, his voice shaking the nine heavens, "Today, this seat will let you see what it means by 'my fate is up to me, not the heavens'!"
As soon as his voice fell, Tongtian swept his large sleeve.
Hum!
A crystal-clear, 12-grade white lotus radiating endless creation and purification power hovered above Tongtian's head.
The sacred, noble, and all-dharma-immune Dao charm instantly swept across the entire scene.
Laozi exclaimed in shock, his originally placid face filled with horror.
"That's impossible! Such a supreme treasure has long been untraceable since the great creation calamity, how could it be in your hands?!"
The anger on Yuanshi's face instantly froze.
He knew better than anyone that a 12-grade lotus platform was enough to suppress a sect's ※26⛬.
Because of this, his so-called "heavenly numbers" from just now completely became a joke.
Jieyin and Zhunti looked at each other, simultaneously seeing the greed flashing past the depths of each other's eyes.
If they obtained this second 12-grade lotus platform, the ※10⛬'s ※26⛬ would become even more stable!
Nuwa seriously looked at Tongtian for the first time.
She originally thought this Third ※12⛬ was affectionate and righteous, yet also indecisive.
But today's Tongtian seemed completely different from her impression.
With the white lotus above his head and ※26⛬ like a rainbow around his body, Tongtian not only showed no signs of loss, but instead became increasingly stable and massive.
He coldly swept his gaze across the Four ※23⛬s, speaking word by word:
"From now on, my Intercept Cult's ※26⛬ will endure through ten thousand kalpas without destruction!"
"Whoever wants to sign this ※7〓 can sign it!"
"Want to use my Intercept Cult ※18〓s to fill the pit? You are more than welcome to try and see whether your bones are hard or this seat's sword of execution is sharp!"
After saying that, Tongtian didn't give anyone a chance to react, turning around and slightly cupping his fists toward ※19⛬ on the high altar.
"※20⛬, since no result can be discussed, this ※18⛬ will not accompany you any further, farewell!"
Wanting to make me act like a grandson right after ※14〓 and letting you slaughter the Intercept Cult at will? In your dreams!
Since I have become Tongtian, and I have the ※21⛬ in hand, the script for this ※7〓 calamity must be written according to my rules!
Tongtian strode forward, stepping directly out of ※8⛬, his back view arrogant to the extreme.
Inside ※8⛬, everyone looked at each other in dismay.
On the high altar, ※19⛬, who had been closing his eyes to rest his mind all along, finally slowly opened his eyes.
He looked at the direction where Tongtian left, a flash of astonishment in his eyes.
The general trend of the ※16⛬ had actually produced a variable?
※19⛬ was silent for a moment, and said calmly, "The matter of the ※7〓 shall be discussed again in a thousand years, you all may withdraw."
Inside ※8⛬, the ※23⛬s left one after another.
※19⛬ pinched his fingers to deduce, and after a long time, his brows finally furrowed.
"A variable..."
"In the ※5⛬, when did there appear an extra variable that even the ※16⛬ cannot see through?"
